يحب (form I)
# يَحِبُّ (yaḥibbu) /ja.ħib.bu/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of حَبَّ (ḥabba)
# يُحَبُّ (yuḥabbu) /ju.ħab.bu/: third-person masculine singular non-past passive indicative of حَبَّ (ḥabba) and حُبَّ (ḥubba)
# يَحِبَّ (yaḥibba) /ja.ħib.ba/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of حَبَّ (ḥabba)
# يُحَبَّ (yuḥabba) /ju.ħab.ba/:
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
